verdict.rationale: An automation platform with its own agents (Zapier Agents) could plausibly act as an MCP client, so this axis applies. However, every MCP item in the pack describes Zapier serving its own tools to external clients such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor. Nothing shows Zapier or Zapier Agents connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools, and server-side evidence cannot be credited for this client-side story.
